eat.name: Twin Anchors Restaurant & Tavern
eat.reserve: No reservations — walk-in only; arrive by ~4:45–5:00 PM Fri for booth before 6:30 show (waits spike later)
eat.order_this: Half slab baby-backs to share + one order zesty sauce on the side; two beers or soft drinks

backup.name: Orso's (OpenTable) → Zanies Cliff Cash 9:15 PM Fri
backup.note: If Twin Anchors wait blows the 6:30 call time: OpenTable Orso’s instead, then Zanies late set—or Second City 9:30pm Mainstage if still available.

couple.transit: Walk Sedgwick Twin Anchors → Second City (1616 N Wells). Tight corridor; leave 20+ min buffer for seat time.
